hard_gates.name: single-program-authority-boundary
hard_gates.evidence: Historical checkpoints required separate authority and did not form one autonomous finite program.

hard_gates.name: finite-correction-policy
hard_gates.evidence: The historical collection did not enforce one shared per-stage invalid-correction limit.

hard_gates.name: physically-separated-evaluation-artifacts
hard_gates.evidence: The historical collection did not share one program-level isolation and hash contract.

hard_gates.name: provider-and-paid-execution-closed
hard_gates.evidence: Historical authorities relevant to this successor are revoked.

hard_gates.name: single-program-authority-boundary
hard_gates.evidence: The manifest exposes one authority state and automatic progression for all nine stages.

hard_gates.name: finite-correction-policy
hard_gates.evidence: Each stage permits at most one harness-only correction and every valid quality result is terminal.

hard_gates.name: physically-separated-evaluation-artifacts
hard_gates.evidence: Public cases, hidden gold, responses, reviewer output, provider accounting, and the program ledger use separate hash-bound stores.

hard_gates.name: provider-and-paid-execution-closed
hard_gates.evidence: Manifest and repository freeze authority are false; build verification made zero provider calls.

decision.rationale: The finite program unifies the academically required factual, visual, tutoring-flow, and reporting checkpoints while preserving deterministic truth, qualified rollback, explicit cost control, and a terminal no-tuning policy.
limitations: This is build-only evidence and does not measure product or model quality.
The benchmark uses open educational sources and synthetic users rather than the private Academia Vault or real students.
OpenAI model configurations are one provider family and their reviews remain advisory.
Synthetic C0-C3 diagnostics do not establish professor fidelity.
External human evaluation, student outcomes, and durable hosting remain outside this program.
